import sys

def main():
    input_lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    totalLines = int(input_lines[0])
    inputStr = input_lines[1].lower()
    originalStr = inputStr
    chArray = list(inputStr)
    sb = list(originalStr)
    stack = []
    for c in chArray:
        stack.append(c)
    bracketPositions = []
    for i, c in enumerate(chArray):
        if c == '(' or c == ')':
            stack.pop()
            bracketPositions.append(i)
    pairMap = {}
    for i in range(0, len(bracketPositions), 2):
        pairMap[bracketPositions[i]] = bracketPositions[i + 1]
    removalIndices = []
    for startIdx, endIdx in pairMap.items():
        for i in range(startIdx, endIdx + 1):
            removalIndices.append(i)
    toRemoveSet = set(removalIndices)
    filteredChars = [chArray[i] for i in range(len(chArray)) if i not in toRemoveSet]
    replacedChars = []
    toggleFlag = True
    for i in range(len(chArray)):
        if i in toRemoveSet:
            if chArray[i] in ['(', ')', '_']:
                if toggleFlag:
                    replacedChars.append(' ')
                    toggleFlag = False
            else:
                replacedChars.append(chArray[i])
                toggleFlag = True
    finalOutput = ''.join(replacedChars)
    afterSplit = finalOutput.split()
    afterLengths = [len(p.strip()) for p in afterSplit if len(p.strip()) != 0]
    replacedStr = inputStr.replaceAll(r"\(.*?\) ?", " ").replace('_', ' ')
    beforeSplit = replacedStr.split()
    beforeLengths = [len(p.strip()) for p in beforeSplit if len(p.strip()) != 0]
    afterLengths.sort()
    maxLen = afterLengths[-1] if len(afterLengths) > 0 else 0
    print(f"{maxLen} {len(beforeLengths)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
